notes:
Screen view of a variant: breadcrumb bar above the canvas, tree map right of the canvas, Variant card in the inspector. Approved direction C (mockup `variants-screen-view` / `c-breadcrumb-tree`), implemented in CHR-732.

Behaviour:
- Breadcrumb bar = crumb per ancestor (`$variant-crumb`: home glyph for the root, kind icon for variants, current crumb in accent) plus a kind chip and a 1-based depth chip, and a `Back to <root>` button on the right. Every crumb carries a disclosure arrow that opens a popover with the node's children and siblings; one click switches the screen (popover drawn open on the last crumb).
- The tree map is a 260px column right of the canvas; the current node is highlighted, every node is clickable.
- The `Variant` card (Path, Kind, Depth, Siblings, Flows in / out) lives in the inspector's Elements tab, not beside the phone. `Also reached from` is a second card there, see `inspector-variant-reached-from`.
- No flow-trail line and no "tap here" annotation (dropped from the mockup). Flow mode landing on a variant only redraws crumbs and map.
